description:
Conversations in this harness are created by copying a versioned template
(docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2). This task builds that template and the
"create a new conversation" tooling. Depends on bl-5bbc (config schemas),
because the template files must parse and validate against the schemas
defined there.

=== Location ===

`template/` at the project root of the lernie repo. The harness binary
reads from it; a CLI subcommand or Makefile target copies it to a target
path and initializes git there.

=== Layout (matches ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2) ===

    template/
    ├── .gitignore                  # ignore runtime state
    ├── .agent/
    │   ├── version                 # "1"
    │   ├── manifest.yaml
    │   ├── workflow.yaml
    │   ├── agents.yaml
    │   ├── providers.yaml
    │   ├── system/
    │   │   ├── prompts/
    │   │   │   ├── base.md
    │   │   │   ├── worker.md
    │   │   │   └── compactor.md
    │   │   ├── skills/             # empty at v0.1
    │   │   └── tools/              # empty at v0.1
    │   └── state/
    │       ├── branches.json       # "{}"
    │       └── events.log          # empty
    ├── exchanges/                  # .gitkeep
    ├── artifacts/                  # .gitkeep
    ├── invocations/                # .gitkeep
    └── tools/                      # .gitkeep

=== Stub content ===

providers.yaml — Anthropic baseline (user has API access there):

    providers:
      anthropic:
        endpoint: https://api.anthropic.com
        auth:
          type: api_key
          env: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
    models:
      claude-sonnet-4-7:
        provider: anthropic
        model_id: claude-sonnet-4-7
        capabilities: [tool_use_native, prompt_caching, streaming, stop_sequences]
        context_window: 200000
      claude-haiku-4-5:
        provider: anthropic
        model_id: claude-haiku-4-5
        capabilities: [tool_use_native, prompt_caching, streaming, stop_sequences]
        context_window: 200000

agents.yaml:

    agents:
      worker:
        model: claude-sonnet-4-7
        system_prompt: prompts/worker.md
      compactor:
        model: claude-haiku-4-5
        system_prompt: prompts/compactor.md

manifest.yaml (mirrors arch §5.1):

    context:
      pinned:
        - .agent/goal.md
        - .agent/system/prompts/base.md
      include:
        - exchanges/**
        - artifacts/**
        - invocations/*/result.md
      budget_tokens: 150000
      overflow: drop_oldest_exchanges

workflow.yaml — baseline variant, no verifier (verifier lives under
experiments/ later, §9.3):

    events:
      user_message:
        - spawn_exchange
        - dispatch(worker)
      worker_return:
        - dispatch(compactor)
        - merge
      branch_stopped:
        - mark_abandoned
        - notify_ui

prompts/:
- base.md: one paragraph framing the harness's contract — goal-first,
  branch-based, every model call is a branch, tools via the tool contract.
- worker.md: worker role description; imports base by reference.
- compactor.md: compactor constraints (deletion-only, scoped to branch
  diff, goal-aware — per arch §2.7).

=== What NOT to include in the template ===

- .agent/goal.md — written at dispatch time (arch §2.8), never in the
  template. The manifest pins it knowing it's only populated inside
  a branch's worktree.
- Sample exchanges, invocations, tool call records, or artifacts — the
  template represents a freshly-created conversation with nothing yet.
- Skills or tools under .agent/system/skills/ and .agent/system/tools/ —
  v0.3 milestone populates those.

=== Create-a-conversation tooling ===

Surface of choice (not prescribed):
- Makefile target: `make new-conversation NAME=foo` -> `cp -r template/
  conversations/foo/ && cd conversations/foo/ && git init && git add -A
  && git commit -m 'initial'`.
- Or a CLI subcommand on the harness binary, if the binary exists by
  then.

Either way: the resulting repo must parse clean through the bl-5bbc
schemas and pass a smoke assertion that every file referenced by
manifest/providers/agents either exists or is a documented
written-at-dispatch file.

=== Deliverables ===

1. template/ directory scaffolded with the layout and stub content above,
   fully committed.
2. .gitkeep files in empty dirs that must exist at copy time
   (exchanges/, artifacts/, invocations/, tools/, .agent/system/skills/,
   .agent/system/tools/).
3. Create-a-conversation tooling (Makefile target or CLI subcommand).
4. Integration test that calls the tooling against a tempdir and then:
   a. Validates every .agent/*.yaml against the bl-5bbc schemas.
   b. Asserts version == "1".
   c. Asserts all manifest paths resolve OR are documented as
      written-at-dispatch.
   d. Asserts prompts referenced in agents.yaml exist.
5. If the arch examples need tightening (e.g. ambiguity about relative
   paths in agents.system_prompt), update docs/ARCHITECTURE.md in the
   same task.

=== Constraints ===

- Terminology: every file and example must conform to ARCHITECTURE.md
  §2.1. The workflow event names and action names used in workflow.yaml
  must match the closed sets defined by the schemas in bl-5bbc.
- No .agent/goal.md in the template. This is load-bearing — don't paper
  over it with an empty stub.
- Coverage: 100% on new code per repo policy.

=== References ===

- docs/ARCHITECTURE.md §2.2 (layout), §2.5 (dispatch/invocations),
  §2.7 (compactor), §2.8 (goal lifecycle), §4–§6 (config files),
  §9.3 (experiments).
- bl-5bbc (config schemas — dep).
- AGENTS.md (worktree discipline; tests/docs/alignment gates).
title: Conversation repo template under template/
